supported_observations: Eleven actual allocated CNN processes remained present through the 10-second window; all observed thread affinities remained within the assigned eight CPUs.
The fixed 88 allowed CNN CPUs were used at about half effective capacity in this window; the process/thread budget is an upper bound, not measured busy cores.
This window records no CNN read/write bytes, no major faults and no cgroup throttling; disk transfer and quota throttling did not explain this sampled gap.
Running and futex endpoint observations coexist. Endpoint counts are not waiting durations.
Numerous minor faults and RSS activity were measured but do not identify an allocator or memory-bandwidth bottleneck.
unknown: Operator-specific parallel efficiency, serial compute fraction, allocator cost and memory-bandwidth limits were not profiled.
A single short sample does not exclude I/O or CPU throttling outside the window, or establish zero impact on training.
throughput_scope: Closed chunks 000..008 contain different useful checkpoints; actual batch throughput does not establish controlled acceleration or global optimum. Existing 1/2/4/8/11 curve remains unchanged.
